data.one_liner: Flutter widgets for 1,300+ free SVG icons from Iconoir, rendered with flutter_svg
data.what_it_does: Provides a widget for each Iconoir icon, allowing easy use in Flutter UI. Icons are SVGs rendered via flutter_svg, supporting color, size, and other common props.
use_when: You need a large set of free, open‑source icons in a Flutter app
You prefer SVGs for scalability and theming
You want a single package that exposes all icons as widgets
avoid_when: You need icons that are not SVG or require raster assets
You need icons with a different design language or brand guidelines
You are already using another icon package that covers your needs
strengths: Icons are SVGs, so scalable and themeable
No external assets or build steps required
weaknesses: Relies on flutter_svg, adding a runtime dependency
No support for custom icon packs or dynamic icon loading
No built‑in theming beyond color and size
data.setup_notes: Add dependency to pubspec and import package
